result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the promotional banner text has very poor contrast against its background.

issues.description: The white headline and secondary promo text in the pale green “3 free deliveries for you” banner are difficult to read because the text has insufficient contrast with the background.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color, darken the banner background, or add a sufficiently opaque overlay behind the text to meet accessible contrast ratios.
